Officer's narrative
Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection area in Baytown, Texas, I found two passenger vehicles stopped at
the curb lane with visible contact damage along the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and the left front side
of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 1 stated that while changing lanes to the left, the side of Driver 2's vehicle came into
contact with their own vehicle. Driver 2 confirmed the lane change and the sideswipe and did not dispute the
sequence. Two independent witnesses on the scene gave statements consistent with both drivers, and each said
they saw the vehicles make contact as described. Photographs taken at the scene match the reported point of impact
and the pattern of the damage. Passenger, who was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, was
present at the time of the collision and confirmed this to me. Driver 1 reported a knee injury from striking the
dashboard area and was assessed at the scene. Based on the position of the vehicles and the nature of the contact,
the damage observed is generally consistent with the reported impact. I found no indication of prior damage to either
vehicle. Driver 1 identified themselves as a household member of the policyholder.
